responsibility: This header declares `test_logical_location`, the checking-build concrete `logical_location` subclass used in GCC selftests. It stores a chosen logical-location kind and name and exposes trivial overrides for the naming and path-output interfaces, giving tests a lightweight logical-location object independent of front-end tree data.
same_name_distinction: Declares the checking-only test_logical_location selftest class and its overrides, while the same-stem .cc file provides the out-of-line method definitions.
